description: Each update type is grouped into one PR per base branch and runs once a week, on its own day, inside a 02:00-08:59 UTC window. MintMaker runs every few hours, so a window holds two runs: the first opens the PR, the second can merge it once CI has passed.
Automerge is on, but master and the redhat-* branches require the all-green check and one code-owner approval, so a PR merges only after review.
Vulnerability fixes ignore the weekly schedule, the grouping and the PR limits (Renovate vulnerabilityAlerts defaults: schedule [], groupName null, prConcurrentLimit 0), so CVE PRs stay immediate.

lockFileMaintenance.description: RPM lockfile refreshes follow the rpm-lockfile weekly window below. MintMaker's global lockFileMaintenance schedule is applied after packageRules, so it has to be set here.

packageRules.description: Disable major version bumps for non-tekton managers

npm: one grouped PR per base branch, Monday 02:00-08:59 UTC. A separate groupName per manager keeps a PR left unmerged from one day from absorbing the next day's updates; group:all would put every manager in one branch.
Python: one grouped PR per base branch, Tuesday 02:00-08:59 UTC.
Go: one grouped PR per base branch (go.mod and config-tool/go.mod), Wednesday 02:00-08:59 UTC.
Docker: one grouped PR per base branch for base image updates, Thursday 02:00-08:59 UTC.
Tekton: Friday 02:00-08:59 UTC. No groupName here: MintMaker's global config already groups the tekton-catalog references into one PR per base branch.
RPM lockfile: Saturday 02:00-08:59 UTC (see rpm-lockfile.lockFileMaintenance above). A lockfile refresh is already one PR per base branch.
